_comment: Per-(side/discriminator) overrides for the type generator. See tools/codegen/README.md.

omitFields._comment: Fields the JS client carries in its function-call surface but DOES NOT send on the wire. JS callback fields (onProgress, logger) live entirely in the client process and are converted to/from streaming AsyncSequences on the Swift side. The generator strips them from the generated structs so the Codable output exactly matches the wire-level JSON.
